pipeline_stages.details: Parsed 26 markdown/PDF docs into 105 child chunks (256 tokens) and parent chunks (2048 tokens)
Generated contextual prepend, questions, and metadata for 105 chunks via optimized single-call prompt
Computed BAAI/bge-m3 1024-dim dense vectors and underthesea tokenized BM25 index for 105 chunks
Initialized BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3 with class-level singleton cache
Average query latency: 920ms/query (Hybrid search: 85ms, Cross-Encoder rerank: 185ms, LLM Generation: 650ms)
Evaluated 80 instances across 4 metrics with RunConfig(max_workers=2, timeout=120) to respect 15 RPM rate limit
